ServicesPage.metaTitle: UK Market Entry Services for Chinese Businesses
ServicesPage.metaDescription: UK market assessment, entry planning, controlled market testing and local business establishment for Chinese manufacturers and brands.

hero.title: UK Market Entry Services
hero.subtitle: From answering whether the UK opportunity is commercially viable to testing it and building the local structure to support it.

item1.question: Should we enter the UK?
item1.name: UK Market Assessment
item1.whatItSolves: Before stock, channels or local infrastructure are committed, we test whether the product has a commercially credible route into the UK.
item1.whoItIsFor: Chinese manufacturers and brands considering the UK for the first time, or revisiting an earlier market-entry assumption.

deliverables.item2: GO / TEST FIRST / NO-GO view with rationale

item1.next: A strong case moves into an entry roadmap. A mixed case is usually better tested in market before larger commitments are made.

item2.question: How should we enter?
item2.name: UK Market Entry Roadmap
item2.whatItSolves: Once the opportunity is credible, the next risk is making disconnected decisions on company structure, products, channels, logistics and budget.
item2.whoItIsFor: Businesses preparing to enter the UK and needing a clear sequence of decisions before execution begins.
item2.next: The roadmap becomes the working reference for a controlled market test or direct execution, depending on the level of remaining uncertainty.

item3.question: Can we prove the opportunity before scaling?
item3.name: 30-Day Market Test
item3.whatItSolves: Research tells us what should happen. A controlled market test shows us what actually happens before larger inventory, marketing or infrastructure commitments are made.
item3.whoItIsFor: Businesses with a credible UK proposition that want real market evidence before scaling investment.

deliverables.item1: Market test report and weekly performance view
deliverables.item2: Pricing, conversion and unit economics findings

item3.next: The evidence determines whether to scale, adjust the proposition or pause before further investment.

item4.question: How do we establish locally?
item4.name: UK Business Establishment
item4.whatItSolves: Once the market case is proven, a sustainable UK presence may require the right entity, operating structure, local resources and specialist professional support.
item4.whoItIsFor: Businesses moving from cross-border market entry toward a longer-term UK commercial and operating presence.

deliverables.item1: UK company setup support, where required
deliverables.item4: Coordination with regulated or specialist advisers where relevant

item4.next: Support can continue as the UK operation develops, with selected European expansion considered where it becomes commercially relevant.

AboutPage.metaDescription: A UK-based advisory helping Chinese businesses make better decisions about UK market entry, testing and local establishment, with selected European expansion support where relevant.

hero.title: Built between China and the UK.
hero.description: We help Chinese businesses make commercially grounded decisions about entering and establishing in the UK, and support selected European expansion where it becomes relevant.

perspective.title: The strategy should come before the service.
perspective.body1: Market-entry providers often begin with the service they already sell: fulfilment, channel management, company formation or something else. Those services may eventually be useful, but they should not determine the strategy.
perspective.body2: We begin with the commercial question, identify what the business actually needs, and then bring together the appropriate expertise for the job.
perspective.photoAlt: The Frankfurt skyline across the Main River, Germany's financial centre

item1.title: UK Market Context
item1.description: Recommendations shaped by UK commercial conditions, regulation and customer expectations rather than assumptions from abroad.

item2.title: China-to-UK Understanding
item2.description: We account for how Chinese manufacturers and brands actually operate, then translate that reality into a workable UK approach.

item3.title: Commercial + Operational Thinking
item3.description: A strategy is only useful if pricing, margin, compliance, logistics and execution can work together in practice.

item4.title: Independent Advice
item4.description: The recommendation is not determined by a marketplace, logistics provider or service we need to sell.

item5.title: Technology-Enabled Research
item5.description: Technology improves research speed and consistency; commercial judgement and accountability remain with the advisory team.

network.title: A coordinated specialist network.
network.description: We remain the central point of coordination.
